summary: Barbara Puffton, along with Edward, serves as a mid-game boss in Sons of the Forest. In this encounter, she uses her speed and agility to perform hit-and-run attacks on the player, making her a formidable opponent. Barbara's primary move is a spin attack, which deals significant damage and requires the player to stay mobile and focused. The recommended strategy for defeating her involves using ranged weapons like a shotgun or pistol to keep a safe distance and aiming for headshots to maximize damage. Proper preparation, including wearing protective armor and carrying healing items, is crucial
name: Barbara Puffton

summary: Blue Puffies are convered in verdigris stains and, in the dark, emit a dim blue light from underneath their skin. Additionally, they are slightly larger than regular Puffies, differenciating them amongst a group.
name: Blue Puffy

summary: Cannibals live in a primitive society organized in "families" (although what defines the composition of a cannibal family remains unclear). They dwell in small Villages dotted around the Island. Cannibals will wear primitive clothing such as loincloths and animal leather rags, but they can also be seen wearing worn off pieces of contemporary clothing, most likely taken from what remained of the human inhabitants of the Island. During the colder Seasons, Cannibals will wear more clothing as well as makeshift coats made of leather and various organs. Occasionally, Cannibal patrols may appear aro
name: Cannibals

summary: Caterpillars consists of what seems to be two people fused at the buttocks. They normally move by performing handsprings to throw each other's torso above the other, moving in a cartwheel fashion. When approaching a target or attacking, they may sometimes move by slithering onto the ground like a worm.
name: Caterpillar

summary: Reprising their counterpart from The Forest, Creepy Virginias appear as a grotesque fusion of several female bodies into a single arachnid-like creature. They emit skittering noises like scorpions or snakes. Creepy Virginias are incredibly agile, thanks to their six claw-tipped legs, they are capable of great leaps allowing them to clear obstacles such as walls. However, their attacks are rather limited, seemingly only being capable of using two of their legs at a time to strike the player. This weakness will allow the player to easily skirt the Creepy Virginia. Category:Enemies Category:Mutan

summary: Fat Cannibals can appear as either male of female, each with their own distinctive appearances and mannerisms. Males are covered head to toe in red body paint or blood, and will always appear completely naked, standing in an intimidating fashion. Female can either appear wearing a loincloth or a makeshift dress made of leather strips, and will usuall cower and exhibit an overall more anxious behavior. Regardless of their gender, Fat Cannibals both share the same move set.
name: Fat Cannibals

Mr & Mrs Puffton are significantly stronger, nimbler and faster than regular Puffies. However, they may inexplicably drop a Skin Pouch upon being killed. Although difficult to visually identify male and female Muddy Cannibals, female are covered in a slightly lighter tone of mud than males. summary: They bear resemblance to great white sharks but with slightly longer secondary dorsal fin and exaggerated pelvic and pectoral fins. Coupling these features with their many scars gives them a more savage appearance.

summary: Sluggy is a large mutated mass of flesh that appears to have humanoid appendages, it is a faceless and legless mutant that can only move by sliding along the ground. However, it possesses multiple arms and is able to release large screeches when attacking the player. Its sheer size and distorted features give it the nickname "The Blob."

summary: The Twins appear as two deformed humans fused at the glutes with coordinated movements. Both of their limbs are extremely elongated and thin, with claw-like hands to strike with and climb walls. One face is deformed and split apart. The two humans the Twins comprised of are mostly similar, but the right one seems to be skinnier and has a dent in its head. If you look at the prominent features, you can see that one is female, and the other is male.
